package.source: Official SteamCMD anonymous app_update validate, followed by the existing trusted-main-app dependency completion. The original incomplete-dependency acquisition remains retained separately.

static_save_contract.abi: void whole_world_flush(WorldPersistenceComponent*, NativeJob*); native writer consumes the owned callable on the game thread.
static_save_contract.method: Read-only comparison with the hash-verified 26552396 baseline: seven unwind-bounded complete functions plus the uniquely located 84-byte leaf weak-owner helper preserve every decoded instruction and internal branch after masking RIP-relative addresses and external branch destinations. New class strings, cross-function calls, SQL text, object offsets and callback layout are independently bound below. This does not establish semantic equivalence of every transitive external callee.
static_save_contract.native_writer: Compacts pending actors at component +0x158; resolves weak owner +0x150; requires database +0x5a0 status slot +0x70 == 2; appends BEGIN/END TRANSACTION around native serialization and submits via database slot +0xb0.
static_save_contract.normalization_scope: External addresses only: RIP-relative memory/code targets and direct branches outside the compared function. Immediate constants, object offsets and all internal branch displacements remain exact.

strict_manual_save.readback_scope: The exact captured manual SQLite checkpoint and server UID were restored after a normal stop and verified by a fresh native process without a second save. No populated-player or building-content identity is established.

static_provider_contract.thread_id_abi: Export 0x6bae jumps to 0x7a030; writes uint32 through RCX and returns the same pointer.
static_provider_contract.async_query_abi: Export 0x5ab0 jumps to 0x1182f0: RCX database, RDX shared_ptr output, R8 builder reference, R9 NativeJob; returns output pointer in RAX.
static_provider_contract.completion: Per-statement results preserve index and status; aggregate dispatch waits for its final result. IsDone is assigned before final SQL execution and cannot independently confirm completion. The adapter must continue observing the original owned callback sequence.
static_provider_contract.method: All nine provider PE sections, import/export tables, ten complete function bodies, and every existing byte guard are byte-identical to the verified baseline. Full-file hash changes only in PE checksum and certificate table.

limits: Only the named FField/FProperty registration/factory functions and four concrete slot46 implementations are compared. This is not an exhaustive proof of every UE5.8 virtual table.

scope_limits: Static comparison covers the named save functions, provider contract and FField/FProperty hierarchy and selected alignment slots, not all gameplay code or all engine virtual tables.
New isolated empty-player worlds only; native completion confirms the owned pending persistent-actor SQL transaction, not hardware fsync or unrelated game state.

Exact manual checkpoint reload is separate from backup/archive restoration. Full restored-world content identity remains unsupported for Conan and was not enabled in the standard lifecycle acceptance.
No populated-world migration, live players, buildings, real-player moderation, GUI, multiplayer discovery or external-connectivity acceptance.
Native binding used the existing default and non-elevated firewall policy; no public connectivity success is inferred.
Official package acquisition was separate. The tests reused its checked copy with pinned updates; no network update or signed desktop installation was exercised.
Candidate02 and candidate04 strict-save successes and all failed attempts are retained independently; only candidate06 supplies the current complete native acceptance.
Full logs, private paths, host identifiers, credentials, game packages and saved data remain outside the repository.

dispatcher_initialization.change: During Conan Lua module loading, initialize the pinned EngineTick dispatcher once and invoke the fixed native prepare export before accepting request files. Preparation validates fixed image/loader/provider files without looking up the current world or publishing/invoking a save. Each queue dispatch now receives its own pinned UE4SS steady-clock delayed-action budget of 3000 ms, avoiding Unix-second quantization. Missing/negative elapsed results reject admission, and an old sentinel can expire only its captured budget. World/generation checks, the original 30-second completion window and no-resend behavior remain in force.
dispatcher_initialization.regression: A synchronous first hook registration longer than the three-second queue budget must finish before the first probe is stamped; first probe/save then runs once.

fixed_native_preparation.scope: fixed image, loader and provider identity/contract preparation only; current-world validation remains per request

queue_timing.clock: pinned UE4SS delayed-action steady_clock elapsed milliseconds
queue_timing.budget_origin: Pinned delayed-action registration before the actual work callback is enqueued; this does not bound total host response latency.
queue_timing.diagnostic_trace_scope: The queued trace precedes timer registration and can include registration preparation or scheduling; its timestamp difference is not a measured timer elapsed value.
